figures.caption: Figure S4. Boxplots showing distribution of decomposition energies of (a) garnet Li_7La_3Zr_2O_12 (LLZO) and (b) garnets LLZO, Li_7La_3Sn_2O_12 (LLSnO), Li_5La_3Nb_2O_12 (LLNbO), and Li_5La_3Ta_2O_12 (LLTaO) with binary oxides and lithium ternary oxides, phosphates, borates, silicates, halides, and nitrides. The center vertical line in each box indicates the median of the data set, the outside edges of the box indicate the first and third quartiles, and the end lines (whiskers) indicate the most extreme value on either end or 1.5 times the interquartile range, whichever is smaller. Data outside the whiskers are marked individually as gray circles. Among the materials classes studied, the lithium ternary oxides have the lowest median reaction energy with LLZO, at approximately 0 eV/atom, indicating a large proportion of this material class has good stability with LLZO. The different garnet classes have similar stability trends with the coating layer materials, suggesting the stability of doped LLZO will not differ significantly from those of LLZO.
